rules.material: Clean matte surfaces, soft plastic controls, restrained shading.
rules.shape: Rounded panels and buttons, consistent medium corner radii and thin borders.
rules.typography: Friendly sans serif; clearly separated title, section and body hierarchy.
rules.icons: Simple rounded pictograms with consistent stroke weight.
rules.decoration: Low density; generous breathing room, no ornate framing.
rules.lighting: Soft upper-left highlights and subtle short shadows.
